description.de: Nach 99 Leben als ‚Profi-Extra' erhält die unschuldig hingerichtete Herzogstochter Billicia eine besondere Macht: Regression! In ihrem 100. Leben will sie aber nicht fliehen, sondern das eisige Herz ihres gefürchteten Vaters erwärmen. Was kann da schon passieren...?
description.en:
I'll make my evil dad good and survive this time!
I was killed for being the villain's daughter, but when I opened my eyes, I was 14 years back in time. Too young and penniless, I decided to wait to escape... But why should I have to run away?! What if I train my dad to be good instead?
description.es:
¡Reformaré a mi malvado padre para sobrevivir!
Me ejecutaron por ser la hija del villano. Creí que ahí terminaría mi vida, pero regresé en el tiempo a mi infancia. Sin dinero y sin fuerzas, decidí esperar a ser más grande para escapar de mi trágico destino. Aunque… ¿no sería mejor si purifico el oscuro corazón de mi padre en lugar de huir?
description.fr: Vilisa est la fille de Kasys Valois, le vilain de l’empire Rolls. Raison suffisante pour être condamnée à mort et exécutée par l’empereur. Mais lorsqu’elle rouvre les yeux, quatorze ans plus tôt, elle se retrouve face à l’événement qui a fait basculer son père dans la folie. Deux choix s’offrent à elle: s’enfuir avant de se retrouver sur l’échafaud ou rester et tenter d’apaiser le chagrin de Kasys. Mais quelles sont ses chances de transformer le vilain en papa poule?
description.it: Renderò buono il mio cattivo padre e sopravviverò questa volta! Sono stata uccisa perché ero la figlia del cattivo, ma quando ho aperto gli occhi, ero tornata indietro di 14 anni nel tempo. Troppo giovane e senza un soldo, ho deciso di aspettare per scappare... Ma perché dovrei scappare?! E se invece alleno mio padre a essere buono?
description.ko:
악역의 딸이라는 이유로 사형당했다.

‘이놈들아, 난 아무것도 안 했다고!’

억울해하며 눈을 뜨니 14년 전으로 돌아왔다.
아직 악역 가문의 보살핌이 필요한 나는 용돈을 모아 탈출하기로 계획했는데…

“죽이면 끝나는 거 아닌가. 골치 아프게 협상을 왜….”
“협상하는 아빠 조아.”
“협상하도록 하지.”

무려 인생 2회차. 금수저가 탈출을 왜 해!?
아빠를 조련해 착한 사람으로 만들었다.

히히. 세상 사람들.
이제 우리 아빠 악역 아니거든요!



아하, 샌드위치 만들다가 그런 거구나.
그럼 그럼!

우리 아빠는 이제 착해졌다구요!
description.th: ฉันจะทำให้คุณพ่อกลายเป็นคนดีและมีชีวิตรอดไปให้ได้! ฉันถูกฆ่าด้วยเหตุผลเพียงเพราะเป็นลูกสาวของคนร้าย พอฉันลืมตาตื่นขึ้นมาอีกครั้ง กลับพบว่าตัวเองย้อนกลับมาเมื่อ 14 ปีก่อน ที่ทั้งเด็กเกินไปและไม่มีเงินติดตัวเลยสักนิด ฉันเลยตัดสินใจที่จะรอสักพักก่อนจะหนี… แต่ทำไมฉันต้องหนีด้วยล่ะ? ในเมื่อฉันสามารถฝึกคุณพ่อให้เป็นคนดีได้นี่?
description.pt-br:
"Depois de 100 vidas como a filha do vilão, tudo o que quero é um final feliz."

Na minha 99ª vida, fui executada só por ser a filha do vilão. Quando voltei a abrir os olhos, percebi que tinha voltado 14 anos no tempo e que estava de volta sob os cuidados da família do vilão. Por causa disso, decidi que precisava juntar dinheiro para fugir. Mas e se eu conseguisse convencer meu pai a não ser mais um vilão e virar uma pessoa legal...?

description.en:
A killer who can completely conceal all traces of his existence has been hired to deal with the target while keeping a low profile.  
  
However, the place where the killer infiltrated was an apartment in Korea that was has poor soundproofing level. Everyone can hear everything that is happening in the apartment.  
  
It is in this place that the killer is to monitor the target until given further instructions. All he wants to do is to complete his mission in peace. However, things just won't go his way.

I've reincarnated in the world of fiction, where characters are decapitated at the hands of villains.

I read the famous gothic novels to cure my timidity and build my courage! Before the real story can begin, I have to get away from the dreaded capital society. So I married a poor baron in the countryside...

"Don't make me pay your bills. Do you understand?"

This man, who shows up at the wedding covered in blood, must be the dreaded villain who kills everyone! Did I, in an attempt to avoid being a villain, marry a man who would be a villain? I'm definitely screwed. I must have married the wrong person!

description.en: All she wanted was an easy life as a noble woman. Instead, Laura Jay found herself involved with a series of drama and a number of courters. She didn't sign up for all the excitement. "Just leave me alone!"
description.fr:
Employée de bureau ordinaire en Corée du Sud, je me suis soudainement retrouvée réincarnée dans le corps de Lorazie Évine, une vilaine emblématique à la vie particulièrement difficile.

Elle, qui n’avait connu que le mépris de sa famille, avait tant cherché leur affection qu’elle en était devenue une véritable antagoniste.
Et maintenant, c’est moi qui dois vivre sa vie.

Alors que je peine à m’adapter à cette existence de “vilaine”, voilà que quatre hommes se déclarent amoureux de moi ?

**– Zion, un esclave venu d’un pays vaincu.
– Damien, le majordome à l’apparence de renard de la famille d'Évine.
– Ethan, le Duc du Nord, qui avait tué Lorazie dans sa vie passée.
– Et Bellicion, un démon entouré de mystères…**

Déjà qu’un seul serait difficile à gérer, en voilà quatre !
Mais Lorazie, peu intéressée par l'amour qu'ils portent à son égard, arrivera-t-elle à faire un choix ?

빙의 전에는 관심도 없던 남자들이 질척대기 시작했다.
노예 출신 호위 기사와, 이 종족 혼혈 집사, 원수였던 대공에, 웬 미친놈까지.
…그냥 다 꺼졌으면 좋겠다.

description.zh-hk: 模特兒李詩雅是一個必須靠著和人類的身體接觸吸收能量才能夠活下去的現代吸血鬼，擁有美麗外貌的詩雅非常輕易就能夠和男人有身體上的接觸，直到她遇到擁有比任何男人的能量都新鮮的申志浩，李詩雅從第一次和他有了身體接觸後就非常渴望能夠擁有他身上的能量，但這個心願卻因為申志浩的潔癖而失敗，李詩雅為了消滅他的潔癖以及得到他身上的能量一步步地越來越靠近他的生活，但兩人之間卻產生了微妙的感情。 女主角必須和人有身體上的接觸才能活下去，而男主角卻討厭跟任何人有身體上的接觸，這個設定讓讀者在看這部愛情漫畫時更津津有味，李詩雅為了和申智厚有身體上的接觸，採取了各式各樣的作戰方式，雖然看起來像場可愛的鬧劇，不過這個想碰又逃跑的過程就像是男女在曖昧期的不安，作者成功描繪出了在超越友情線前男女間起伏不平的心情。

description.en: Ji-hyeok, a public defender, was living a hard life looking at his daughter, who was not worth it. Ji-hyeok, who lost his life along with his daughter in a car accident, asks God. “Because I don’t need it!! I just need to see my daughter again!!” After such a persistent request, he arrives in a new world with the power of observation and persuasion, and Ji-hyeok finds out that he is the devil’s butler and lawyer. And he finally comes face to face with the Demon King…. “So Eun-ah…” Surprisingly, the Demon King was in the form of his daughter. The Demon King’s Castle, which was destroyed by the luxury and pleasure of the previous Demon King! Attack of the warriors! The protests of monsters are pouring in every day! Only Ji-hyeok can protect her daughter!

Junseong Kim had a hard life living secretly as a pro gamer to pay off his late parents’ debts before dying in a tragic accident. But his luck changes when he is reincarnated into another world as a boy named Elemis.

description.en:
The story set in the contemporary South Korea. Some 30 years ago, unidentified creatures appeared out of nowhere and have attacked people. They have caused massive destruction wherever they go. The monsters are called "Trouble", and get the world have fallen into chaos. Along with the first appearance of the "Troubles", some number of humans were born with or acquired supernatural abilities. These mutants called "Trace" are the only ones who can fight off the "Trouble". The "Trace" are also considered freaks and generally shunned by the community because some of them misused the powers for their own interest.  
  
The plot revolves around two main characters. Sah Gang-kwon, a high school student born as a "Trace" who attempts to hide his ability. The other is Kim Yun-Seong, who acquired his "Trace" abilities during his early 30s. Soon after the acquision, his wife and daughter were taken away from him for experimental purposes.

Ian is a painter with a natural-born talent, but his love for painting is soon lost after being forced to work for the cruel and greedy Bardi family. No one knows that he's the genius behind the beautiful works of art that the famous family claims as their own. That is until one day, when the wealthy merchant Raymond comes for a portrait and his interest in Ian is piqued… Can Raymond help him to see the beauty in the world again? Or will Ian's true talent forever remain unseen?

Eunha, whose dream is to become a teacher, has finally become a university student. However, she discovers that her childhood friend and first love, Ha Seungmin, is also in her class. Seungmin used to be a bully in middle and high school and had almost cut ties with Eunha. But now, he seems to be getting closer to her.

As life gets harder, Ian pushes his emotions away and resists. His father's violence and debts increase. Thee misfortunes continued and his body became increasingly numb, he accidentally walks in on an illegal fight and receives an offer.

"If you get in the game, I will give you all the money on this floor."

His survival period begins, where he must survive in an illegal fighting arena.

Naranda is a country where mermaids are said to have lived in the sea once upon a time.
Yeonji joins the Naranda Historical Research Institute as an intern to prove it.
She has been dreaming of a mermaid since she was a child.
At the institute, she meets her team leader, Hae-rang, who looks like the mermaid from her dreams.
She tries her best to impress Hae-rang, but she's not impressed with her...

The mystery of her past life, sinking to the bottom of the sea with the kingdom of Naranda begins to unfold!

해랑에게 잘보이고 싶은 연지는 열심히 노력해보지만 해랑은 쌀쌀맞기만 한데...

“Give me the strongest Norma.”

She became a villain who blackened the male lead in a devastated novel. Having already regressed nth times, she decided. She would save the male lead trapped in the bas**ent and escape. Finally, his identity was revealed and a happy ending was just around the corner. What do you mean abuse? She fed and dressed him herself, so she only had to run away.

“I’m going to chase you to hell, master.”

The male lead seemed to be too immersed.

Instead, she plans to rescue Redian, the male lead trapped in her family’s Subterranean Castle, nurture him, and then escape. But why is his intense gaze fixed on her? 피폐소설 속 남주를 흑화하게 만든 악녀로 빙의했다.
이미 N번의 빙의를 말아먹었던 나는 결심했다.
지하실에 갇힌 남주를 구하고 탈출하겠다고.

“내가 지켜줄게."

드디어 남주의 정체가 밝혀지고 해피엔딩이 눈앞이었다.
학대는 무슨, 손수 먹이고 입혀 가며 키워 놨으니 도망갈 일만 남았는데….

“저를 이렇게 버리시면….”

“지옥까지 쫓아갈 겁니다, 주인님.”

남주가 너무 과몰입해 버린 것 같은데?
description.pl: Po niezliczonych reinkarnacjach jako skazane na zagładę czarne charaktery, Pani Transmigrator dostaje ostatnią szansę na napisanie losu na nowo - jako Ciani Felicité, kobieta, która doprowadziła głównego bohatera do szaleństwa! Zamiast tego planuje uratować Rediana, głównego bohatera uwięzionego w podziemnym zamku jej rodziny, wychować go, a następnie uciec. Ale dlaczego jego intensywne spojrzenie skupia się na niej? Czy przy tak dużej uwadze może naprawdę poprowadzić tę reinkarnację do szczęśliwego zakończenia?
description.ru:
— Дайте мне самую сильную Норму.
Она стала злодейкой, которая осквернила главного мужского персонажа в разрушенном романе.
Уже в энный раз вернувшись, она решила что спасет главного героя, запертого в подвале, и сбежит.
Наконец, его личность была раскрыта, и счастливый конец был не за горами.
Что вы имеете в виду под жестоким обращением? Она сама кормила и одевала его, так что ей оставалось только убежать.
— Если ты вот так меня бросишь...
Редиан, ставший наследным принцем, крепко держал ее за руку.
— Я собираюсь преследовать тебя до самого ада, хозяйка.
Главный герой, казалось, был слишком погружен в происходящее.
description.uk: «Дайте мені найсильнішу Норму». Вона стала лиходійкою, яка зламала головну чоловічу роль у спустошеному романі. Регресувавши вже n-й раз, вона вирішила врятувати головного героя з дна і текти. Нарешті його особу було розкрито, і щасливий кінець був не за горами. Нарешті, їй вдалося провести його на п'єдестал... «Якщо ви кинете мене отак…» сказав Редіан, який став наслідним принцом, міцно тримаючи її за руку. «Я поженуся за тобою в пекло, господарко». Здається, вона занадто приручила головного героя.
description.vi: "Đưa cho tôi người Norma mạnh nhất". Cô trở thành một nhân vật phản diện bôi đen nam chính trong một cuốn tiểu thuyết tàn khốc. Đã thoái lui lần thứ n rồi, cô quyết định. Cô sẽ cứu nam chính bị mắc kẹt trong lòng đất và trốn thoát. Cuối cùng, danh tính của anh đã được tiết lộ và một kết thúc có hậu sắp đến gần. Ý cô là lạm dụng? Cô tự mình cho anh ăn và mặc quần áo cho anh nên cô chỉ còn cách chạy trốn. “Nếu em vứt bỏ tôi như thế này…” Redian, người đã trở thành thái tử, nắm chặt tay cô. “Tôi sẽ đuổi theo ngài xuống tận địa ngục, chủ nhân.” Nam chính có vẻ đắm chìm quá mức.
description.pt-br: “Dê-me a Norma mais forte.” Ela se tornou uma vilã que denegriu o protagonista masculino de um romance devastado. Já tendo regredido enésimas vezes, ela decidiu. Ela salvaria o protagonista masculino preso e escaparia. Finalmente, sua identidade foi revelada e um final feliz estava chegando. O que você quer dizer com abuso? Ela mesma o alimentou e vestiu, então só teve que fugir. “Se você me jogar fora assim…” Redian, que se tornou o príncipe herdeiro, segurou a mão dela com força. “Vou persegui-lo até o inferno, mestre.” O protagonista masculino parecia estar muito imerso.

description.en:
“If I were given another chance…” 

10 years after the apocalypse began on Earth, while he faced imminent death, Yoohyun was filled with regret. Just then, a bright light descended upon him. When he opened his eyes, he was greeted by an unfamiliar scene… Not only had he reincarnated as a non-human race called “Teller,” but he had also traveled back in time by 10 years! 

“Now that it has come to this, I’ll live my best life this time!” 

Unlike his previous life, where he was solely focused on survival, he is now determined to lead a successful life. In this new life he has gained, will Yoohyun truly be able to become the protagonist?

description.pt-br: “Se me fosse dada outra oportunidade…” 10 anos após o início do apocalipse na Terra, enquanto enfrentava a morte iminente, Yoohyun estava cheio de arrependimento. Nesse momento, uma luz brilhante desceu sobre ele. Quando ele abriu os olhos, ele foi saudado por uma cena desconhecida… Não só ele tinha reencarnado como uma raça não-humana chamada “Teller”, mas ele também tinha viajado de volta no tempo por 10 anos! “Agora que chegou a esse ponto, vou viver minha melhor vida dessa vez!” Ao contrário da sua vida anterior, em que se concentrava apenas na sobrevivência, agora está determinado a levar uma vida de sucesso. Nesta nova vida que ganhou, será que Yoohyun conseguirá realmente tornar-se o protagonista?

Soo-ah is about to marry a sweet man named Hamin. In front of her is Lee Gyeom, whom she has been crushing on for 19 years.
Six years ago, Lee Gyeom left for abroad without saying a word, and for 19 years he refused to confess,
He proposes to Soo-ah, who is three months away from getting married...

“If you marry him, you will die.”
Surprised by the situation, Soo-ah keeps him at arm's length, but he begins to intrude into her life.
“Why are you doing this now?

Once, I loved him so much, but he hated me so much.
Now, the man who promises to marry me and loves me only for me, Hamin.

Kim Jiyeon, a college student on hiatus living an ordinary life, suddenly finds herself transmigrated into the romance novel *Saint's Flower* shown to her by a friend. She becomes the character Iolara, who only appeared halfway through the novel. The romantic world of the female lead and the male lead, which clearly isn't hers.

Still, she thought she could be happy as one of the characters in the novel. Like she had become the novel's protagonist. But everyone despises her. Hates her.

She's Iolara, the villain who torments the female lead, a fake saint. But it's not true. Iolara herself was the true saint.

Returning to the beginning with the blessings of the gods, she didn't need her family, the people who hated her, the position of the saint, or her beloved fiancé. She was going to walk a different path from her past.

Even when I tried to walk away, I couldn’t ignore their innocent eyes and their need for comfort…

광기로 물든 싯붉은 눈이 휘었다.

“난 아닌데.”

ㅡ

하인리는 내 리본을 붉디붉은 입술로 물고 끌러내렸다.
스으윽― 얇은 천이 어긋나는 소리가 아슬아슬하게 귓가를 스쳤다.

ㅡ

제 등 뒤에 수많은 노예들을 가둬 놓고 내게 ‘프로포즈’하는 저 인간은.

해피엔딩을 위하여 꼬맹이들을 키웠을 뿐인데,
무서운 집착 광공들이 날 잡아먹으려고 한다.

Welcome to *The Adversary of the Evil Dragon*!
I am a guide for travelers who have come into the novel.
You have become 'Tiarozeti Isol'
To return to your original world, you must complete the novel.

"You have to be happy… I will miss you."

Somehow, I fell in love with the male protagonist, Lexion Spero, and ended the story by dying for him, but strangely, when I opened my eyes, I was still in the novel...?

"The new main character is Tiarozeti Isol."
However, this time, not only have I become the main character-

"-Titi, choose me, not this damn fate."
Unlike the previous life, Lexion's obsession for her begins!

---
After Tiarosetti learns from her Guide that sacrificing herself to save the male lead, Lexion Spero, and following the plot is the only way to return to her world, she desperately carries out her role. But confusion strikes when she wakes up where her story starts, and Lexion saves her before he should. The Guide states she's now the main character, and Lexion isn't the male lead! Can Tiarosetti find her way home, or will Lexion's inconsistent behavior shackle her to his world forever?
description.fr:
Après que Tiarosetti ait appris de son guide que se sacrifier pour sauver le protagoniste masculin, Lexion Spero, et suivre l'intrigue est le seul moyen de retourner dans son monde, elle remplit désespérément son rôle. Mais la confusion survient lorsqu'elle se réveille là où son histoire commence, et Lexion la sauve avant qu'il ne le devrait. Le Guide indique qu'elle est désormais le personnage principal, et Lexion n'est plus le personnage principal masculin! Tiarosetti parviendra-t-il à rentrer chez lui, ou le comportement incohérent de Lexion l'enchaînera-t-il pour toujours à son monde?

---
«Bienvenue dans le monde de l'adversaire du Dragon.»

Me voilà transportée dans l'univers d'un roman, guidée par le livre lui-même. L'objectif que je dois atteindre en tant que Tia Rozetti pour rentrer dans mon monde est de terminer l'histoire. Le seul problème est que je dois suivre à la ligne le script et si jamais je m'éloigne de l'histoire originale, ce que je souhaite le moins arrivera. J'ai donc fais mon possible pour suivre les règles, mais des sentiments non voulus ont commencés à apparaîtrent dans mon cœur pour le héros de l'histoire, Lexion Sparrow, à la toute fin de l'histoire je me suis donc sacrifiée pour lui et pour cette action toute l'histoire du livre à changé et m'a fait revenir au début du roman.

Que dois-je faire maintenant? Suivre la véritable histoire ou ma propre voie?

She believed he was a heartless husband and treated him badly. 

Until he was hunted down as a traitor in order to protect her.

‘My dear wife. Please stay safe.’ 
Her heart was torn to pieces as she knelt before his severed arm. But this time, she could see that his body was clearly intact. 

“Your highness? Why are you crying all of a sudden?” 

She had returned after losing hope, to the first night of their wedding three years ago. 
“You must be nervous about your first night. Don’t worry. I didn’t plan to spend the night with the princess anyway.” 

“Why? Aren't I your wife? Forget it, let’s undress and head to bed.” 

“…Your highness?” She tugged at his arm with force. 

'This time, I will certainly protect you. Even if I die trying, I would rather die with you. Not as Nirszeg’s princess, but your wife, Agnes Arpad,' she pledged with determination.

---

Our main character, code name “01”, works as a mercenary who happens upon an old acquaintance. He’s then given a job to protect and transport Enoch, a girl who is sought out to be the perfect “material”, to the borders of Canada.

description.en: TaeHee, who wants to become beautiful, and DoHa, the cosmetic surgeon. Can their outer shells make them happy?

By chaos, the world began to be invaded.

One day, gates suddenly appeared in the world, unleashing monsters upon humanity. The situation brought humanity to the brink of extinction.

The martial world of Eun, the world of magic and knights Einhart, and the world of demons Gehenna became interconnected, and superhumans from these worlds swept away the monsters.

However, they were not righteous saviors.

Under the law of survival of the fittest, the newly emerged Players of Earth were oppressed.

Lee Ro-Woon sought to mediate between the Players and the superhumans from other worlds, aiming to bring peace to the world.

But due to the discomfort of the superhumans from other worlds with his actions and the betrayal of his comrades, Lee Ro-Woon lost everything and fell into ruin. At the moment he was about to give up everything, he became the vessel of chaos and was transported to a sealed world.

There, he encountered three supreme beings.

Lee Ro-Woon becomes the disciple of the Three Kings and rises to rule over everything!
description.ko:
혼돈으로 의해, 세계가 침범당하기 시작했다.

어느 날 갑자기 세상에 게이트가 생기면서 몬스터들이 쏟아져 나오기 시작했다.
인류의 멸망을 목전에 둔 상황.

무림의 세계 '은'과 마법과 기사들의 세계 '아인하트'. 그리고 마인들의 세계 '게헨나'가 연결되어 초인들이 몬스터들을 쓸어낸다.

하지만 그들은 정의로운 구원자가 아니었다. 

강자존의 법칙으로 새로이 탄생한 지구의 '플레이어'들을 핍박한다.

이로운은 플레이어와 타세계의 초인들을 조율해 세상을 평화롭게 하고자 한다.
 
이로운의 행보를 불편하게 여긴 타 세계의 초인들과 동료들의 배신으로 인해, 모든 것을 잃고 폐인이 되어 나락으로 떨어진다. 

모든 것을 포기하려던 순간. 혼돈의 그릇이 되어 봉인된 세계로 전송이 되어 만나게 된 것은 세 명의 절대 강자.

이로운은 삼왕의 제자가 되어, 모든 것 위에 군림한다!

description.en:
In my 24th year of reincarnation, I was living a peaceful life as an insignificant knight commander barely mentioned in the original story. Content with my uneventful existence, I avoided meddling in the main plot.

But during an undercover investigation, I accidentally stumbled upon the villain in the act.

"Sir Clara, have you been waiting for this opportunity? Clever, very clever."
"No, no! I swear to the gods, I have no intention of exposing your identity!"
"Hah, and what reason do I have to trust you?"

That’s how the shadowy mastermind decided to keep me under his watchful eye.

"Here, take this. I bought it just for you."
"Why would I accept this...?"
"The flower matches the color of your hair. And now that I see it, it suits you perfectly."

Wait... why does everyone think the villain is pursuing me out of affection?
This was not part of the plan!

Welcome to a world where Korea still has the royal family living their lives! But for Che-Kyung, a high-school girl, this is a tragedy, since she has to marry the prince who turns out to be a total jerk!

title.en: The Genius Actor Who Brings Misfortune

description.en: “You’ll get hurt if you’re close to him.” “I don’t know why he’s so unlucky.” “Yeonjae, I’m scared of you…” “Lee Yeonjae,” avoided by everyone as if just being near him beings misfortune. Even he thinks it’s weird. Why do bad things only happen around me? I wonder how it feels to live a life of being loved and not hurting those around me. But, was even wishing for that too much? —Bam!! After an accident, I woke up in a strange place facing a mysterious entity. “Strange. You should’ve died according to your fate, so why are you still alive?” One truth I learned after meeting that entity is, [I can avoid misfortune if I act like someone else.] To survive, I have to become an actor.

Chiwoo’s got issues. Upon returning to school after the “incident” last year, he vows to keep to himself and stay out of trouble until graduation. Easier said than done: his bad boy reputation has made him the talk of the school, and Kyujin - class president and model student - won’t stop being friendly. Trouble arrives soon enough in the shape of Jihyun, a tattooed hunk from Chiwoo’s dark past. It’s gonna be a tough year…
